lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Is that everyone?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: For today's special lesson, we're doing physical training.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}, you've been excelling in the theory classes.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: But your results in the practical evaluations have been pretty dismal.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: In other words, your stamina is lacking.
That's because I'm not a Nikke!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's nothing but an excuse.
How is that an excuse...?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: So, you will undergo stamina training.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The other students will warm up and take some time to assess their stamina.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Yay! I was starting to get tired of all those weird special lessons.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: We finally get to take it easy today!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Naru, it's time to check your stamina.

lines.speaker: naru1
lines.text: Stamina check.

lines.speaker: naru2
lines.text: Battery?

lines.speaker: naru3
lines.text: 128 hours of operation remaining.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: All stamina checks are done.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: You need to check your own stamina, not Naru's.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Naru's the one who runs around the most anyway.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Amy, are you confident about your stamina?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm not really big into running myself.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm not very confident, but I do think this will be a great lesson.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Tactics are important when you're up on the surface, but in the end, it all comes down to stamina.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Long-distance running, endurance, and perseverance..

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: These are all crucial.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're certainly fired up.
Being amongst Nikkes in a physical training class...
It's kinda scary.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Now, then.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's do some warm-up exercises before we start our run.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Everyone pair up.
Everyone quickly pairs up with their friends.
I wonder who would team up with me...
There's Arcana, standing there looking bored, without a partner.
And then Privaty, looking around at all the students.
Who should I do my warm-up stretches with?
Arcana.
Privaty.
I walk over to Arcana.
Arcana, let's pair up?
Arcana's bored, almost lonely expression, brightens instantly.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, sure!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey, are you good at exercising?
... Hey?
... Are we still doing that role play?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
This is just a warm-up, so try doing this.
I bend forward while standing and grab my ankles.
I'm not that flexible, but this much should be...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Nnngh!
Arcana stays almost completely upright, only stretching her arms straight forward.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hnnnngh...!
What are you doing...?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm stretching.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hnngh...!
L-let's try something else.
I sit on the floor and spread my legs.
Sure enough, my inner thighs are screaming in protest thanks to my lack of flexibility.
Sit like this, and then... huh?
Arcana crouches down in front of me, watching me.
What is it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You seriously think I'm gonna sit like that, with this short skirt?
Oh...
You're right, that won't do.
... Still, you need to stretch.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I don't mind if it was just you, but there are other people around.
Arcana stands up and holds out her hand.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's do something else. Something we can do together.
Okay then.
As I grab Arcana's hand to stand up...
Huh?
Even though I barely put any weight on her—
*Thud*
There's no support from her at all, and I fall flat on my butt.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Huh?!
Arcana tumbles into my arms.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wow, you're really strong.
You didn't do that on purpose, did you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What do you think?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You really want to see me stretch that badly?
What?!
Arcana laughs, then plops down onto the floor.
She presses down the hems of her skirt and spreads her legs.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hnnngh!
She splits her legs to about 70 degrees.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wow, that's gotta be a new record!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's almost 90 degrees, right?
After finishing warm-ups with Arcana, who is stiff enough to put a log to shame,
we start running around the gym as Privaty instructed.
*Huff, huff...*
After a few laps, I can feel the sweat starting to build.
The gym shirt I'm wearing is starting to feel a bit stifling...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You've got this, {AccountData.NickName}!
I stop for a moment in front of Arcana, who's sitting in the stands watching.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Huh? What is it?
Here.
I take off my gym shirt and drape it over Arcana's head.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What...?
Hold onto this for me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Okay.
Leaving Arcana behind along with my shirt, I start running again.
Whew...
When gym class ends, I head back to the stands again, but...
Huh?
Arcana is nowhere to be seen.
I look around, then approach a student who's heading out.
Her name was... Amy, I think.
Hey, Amy. Can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Yes?
The girl who was here... I mean...
The student with long blue hair, did you see where she went?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Ah, you mean Arcana?
Oh, you know her?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Yeah, we've met. She's my dorm roommate.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: She went back to the dorms earlier.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Said she needed to change clothes.
Thanks.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: No problem.
After saying goodbye to Amy, I head toward the dorms.
I approach Privaty.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Hmm? What are you doing over here?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I thought I told you to pair up?
There's an odd number of students in the class, so we're short one person.
Will you pair up with me?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-I knew someone would end up without a partner...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Looks like that's you.
If you're uncomfortable with it, I'll just work on my own.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: N-no!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I planned this as a partner activity, so I guess I'll work with you this time.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Now then, is everyone paired up?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName} and I will demonstrate, so just watch and follow along.

lines.speaker: students
lines.text: Yes, Miss Privaty.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: First, one person sits on the floor with their legs spread.
I sit and spread my legs.
Thanks to my inflexibility, my inner thighs already feel like they're screaming.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The other person stands behind and pushes them from the back.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: On the inhale, relax slightly, and on the exhale, stretch all the way down slowly.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's begin.
*Inhale*
Inhale, and relax...
*Exhale*
Exhale, and stretch down.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're stiffer than I expected.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm going to apply a bit of pressure, so bear with me.
No, wait...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Inhale again...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Now, exhale!
Privaty presses down on my back with both hands.
This time, she starts using her entire body to press down on me.
I can't think straight with her pressing down on my back.
W-wait a second, Miss Privaty!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You've stretched much farther down than before.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's go again.
*Exhale*
I need to numb my senses and clear my mind entirely.
But...
My body reacts faster than my mind.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good, now switch roles.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: If you can't even straighten your back and have to crawl around like that, you really ought to stretch more.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: If you ever need assistance, just let me know. I can help.
Mmm...
Luckily, pressing down on Privaty's back helps calm me down pretty quickly.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: All right, next pose.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: One person, lie with your arms spread out, then press your right leg over your left.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Your partner should gently press down on your body to keep your hips and legs from lifting off the floor.
Following Privaty's instructions, I lie on my back with my arms spread and bring my right leg across my left.
Privaty places her upper body over my leg and presses down.
Privaty's face gazing down at me, and feeling her on my leg—
No, don't think. Don't look.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh, you're doing much better with this pose.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll apply a bit more pressure...
*Pushhh*
Oh, please, no!
Miss Privaty, gently, please...
Even with my eyes closed, I can feel hair falling over my face.
No, don't think about it.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I must say, looking down at you while you're this vulnerable...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: it feels pretty good.
Try to stay composed.
Start to lost my composure.
I am cosmic dust.
Dust particles gather and turn into eraser crumbs.
Which clump together and become an eraser.
With it, I erase it all, one by one.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The next pose is—
Privaty's voice fades.
My body moves mechanically.
*Clap*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's it for the warm-up.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Physical movement is good for you, so do it often.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Now, let's move on to the full exercise.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We'll start light, with 10 laps around the gym.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's all for today's class.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good job, everyone.
Finally. The long, grueling test of endurance is over...
... You're going to regret this.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Sorry...?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Miss Privaty, I'm exhausted!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Can we switch places already?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh, sure! Time to switch, everyone.
This time, Privaty lays down on the floor.
I grab her thighs and ankles,
and lean my body over her.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ack... Ngh...!
Miss Privaty, you shouldn't be closing your eyes.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-I never said we had to keep our eyes open!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Also...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're too close!
You're quite flexible, so I really need to apply some pressure.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's fine, but you don't have to go this far...!
Ah, so that's why Privaty said it felt good earlier.
Seeing Privaty beneath me, her eyes squeezed shut as she blushes,
stirs excitement and a sense of superiority within me for the first time.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Nngh...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Th-that's enough warming up!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's move on to the main lesson for today!
Huh? But we only did two poses.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Everyone seems to have energy to spare, so I think we're good to go.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: First up, let's do thirty laps around the gym!
Oh no, I'm doomed...
*Huff, huff, huff*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's all for today's class.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Remember, physical training strengthens both body and mind.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's set aside time to do this more often in the future.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Good job, everyone.
Privaty saunters out of the gym.
*Huff...* I feel like I'm going to die of exhaustion...
I'm so drenched in sweat that going straight back to the dorms feels a little gross.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Now that we've worked up a sweat, let's go get some dessert!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Parfait! Parfait!
The other students scatter in all directions.
Good, now's my chance to slip away.
There's a shower room next to the gym, so I'll wash up there before heading back to the dorm.
Covered in sweat, I head straight to the showers.
